-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST','EDS','EDS','TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST','TRU',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SNAPSHOT';GO
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST','EDS_STG','D360','STG_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST','TRU',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SNAPSHOT';GO

-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_STG_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST','TSK_EDS_TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST',NULL; GO
